content: Yazdī collection item 1: a request (multamas) from Muḥammad Ṣūfī b. Ghiyās al-Dīn Tarkhān, presumably addressed to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī, for a volume of Ibn Turka's works in Persian, with an effusive description of their virtues; it states that Ibn Turka's writings are directed in particular toward the ūlū l-aydī wa-l-abṣār (YMN/V ff. 59a-60a, YMN/MS pp. 160-61; continues on pdf p.168).
